semantics.clock: All sequential updates occur on positive clk edges, as specified.
semantics.reset: Active high synchronous reset overrides other inputs and returns to empty pattern search; all outputs then low.
semantics.search: Sample serial data each rising edge while searching; detect contiguous 1101, retaining overlapping prefix matches.
semantics.shift: After the edge receiving the final 1 of 1101, shift_ena is high for exactly four complete clock cycles; four further rising edges shift the duration bits. Ignore control inputs during these cycles.
semantics.count: After the fourth additional data edge, counting is high. A subsequent rising edge with done_counting high enters notification.
semantics.notification: done remains high until a rising edge samples ack high; that edge returns to empty search. Data at that acknowledgment edge is not part of a new pattern.
semantics.initialization: No power-up state is specified; do not initialize RTL. Verification establishes state with synchronous reset.

numeric.counter_datapath: Not included; done_counting is supplied externally
numeric.output_encoding: Moore outputs; at most one output asserted

verification.oracle: Independent history-based pattern detector and phase/cycle model derived from original text
verification.sampling: Drive inputs on falling edges; check outputs before rising edge and after NBA settling
verification.cases: Pattern overlaps and near misses, four shift cycles, immediate and delayed completion/ack, ignored inputs, synchronous reset in all phases, exhaustive short serial streams and deterministic random cycles
verification.success: Fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, explicit PASS line

specification_ambiguities: Power-up state is unspecified; only behavior after a sampled reset is checked.
Text does not explicitly describe overlap handling; search for every occurrence of contiguous 1101 implies preserving overlapping prefixes.
